figurative_meaning_bn: দুহাতে টাকা খরচ করা; অপব্যয় করা
figurative_meaning_en: To spend money lavishly; to squander or waste money
similar_in_english: Money burns a hole in one's pocket
example_sentences_in_english: He threw money around during the festival.
The young man is squandering his money on luxuries.
note: This idiom reflects Bengali cultural emphasis on frugality contrasted with occasional extravagance.
